AhaShelf

Read lecture slides alongside the transcript, so revisiting a point does not mean replaying the whole recording.

The question behind it is how to make a lecture useful after watching it: keep the visual material beside what was said, so a reader can revisit a point in context.

In development: illustrated handouts are still being refined.
